title.value: MAPL : Parameter-Efficient Adaptation of Unimodal Pre-Trained Models for Vision-Language Few-Shot Prompting
title.justification: The title clearly indicates that this paper deals with a method called MAPL aimed at adapting unimodal pre-trained models for vision-language tasks in a parameter-efficient way.
title.quote: MAPL : Parameter-Efficient Adaptation of Unimodal Pre-Trained Models for Vision-Language Few-Shot Prompting

extractions.description: This paper introduces MAPL, a method that adapts pre-trained unimodal vision and language models for multimodal vision-language tasks. MAPL leverages a lightweight mapping network between visual and textual representations, enabling the use of strong generalization capabilities from frozen pre-trained models. The approach is tested on tasks like image captioning and visual question answering, demonstrating superior or competitive performance with significantly fewer trainable parameters.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The central theme of the paper is the adaptation of pre-trained models for vision-language tasks, focusing on parameter efficiency and few-shot learning. It does not explicitly address sustainable development goals related to climate or ecological sustainability.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote:
Over the past few years, natural language processing and computer vision have witnessed impressive
progress in learning models capable of transferring
to unseen tasks or benchmarks...

primary_category.justification: The paper does not focus on climate or ecological sustainable development. Instead, it is centered on methodological advancements in deep learning models for vision and language tasks.
primary_category.quote: This paper addresses MAPL, a parameter-efficient method capable of tackling unseen VL tasks, not specifically related to climate or ecological domains.

secondary_categories.justification: Similarly, secondary aspects of this paper do not inherently focus on sustainability but rather on model efficiency and application in vision-language tasks.
secondary_categories.quote: The paper provides no indication of focus on secondary sustainability themes.

primary_sub_category.justification: There are no direct sub-categories related to climate or ecological sustainable development mentioned or implied in the paper.
primary_sub_category.quote: The focus remains on model efficiency and adaptation for VL tasks, not on ecological or climate-related sub-categories.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: Again, there are no apparent sub-categories related to sustainability themes.

new_primary_category.justification: The pre-defined categories do not fit the focus of the paper, which is primarily on machine learning and model adaptation efficiencies.
new_primary_category.quote: This work shows how one can easily adapt pre-trained vision encoders and LMs for multimodal tasks.

new_primary_sub_category.quote: The architecture of our mapping network has some similarities with that in ClipCap and the Perceiver Resampler in Flamingo.
